name: pam_usb
detailed_description: PAM module using USB keys/tokens as authentication tokens. Requires insertion of USB device to authenticate, providing hardware-based two-factor authentication.

parameters.user_keys_dir: Directory containing user USB key configs
parameters.allow_fallback: Allow fallback to password if USB missing

notes:
Provides hardware-based MFA. Requires physical USB token provisioning.
